## Pull request overview

This PR implements a comprehensive **Unified API Registry and Documentation System** that addresses the core problem of managing heterogeneous API types (REST, GraphQL, OData, WebSocket, File, Auth, and Plugin-registered APIs) in a centralized manner with OpenAPI generation and interactive testing interfaces.

**Changes:**
- Added centralized API registry protocol supporting 10 API types with complete metadata tracking
- Implemented OpenAPI 3.0 specification generation with support for 9 interactive testing UIs (Swagger UI, Redoc, GraphQL Playground, GraphiQL, RapiDoc, Stoplight, Scalar, Postman, custom)
- Added advanced features including RBAC integration, dynamic schema linking (ObjectQL references), protocol extensibility, and priority-based route conflict resolution

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 35 out of 35 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/api/registry.zod.ts | Core API registry protocol with 848 lines defining 10 protocol types, endpoint registration, discovery queries, and conflict resolution strategies |
| packages/spec/src/api/documentation.zod.ts | OpenAPI spec generation schemas, testing UI configurations (9 types), test collections, changelog tracking, and code generation templates |
| packages/spec/src/api/registry.test.ts | Comprehensive test suite with 992 lines covering all registry features including RBAC, dynamic schemas, priorities, and protocol configs |
| packages/spec/src/api/documentation.test.ts | Test suite with 617 lines validating OpenAPI specs, UI configs, test collections, and changelog entries |
| packages/spec/src/api/registry.example.ts | Production-ready examples demonstrating RBAC, dynamic schemas, protocol extensibility, and route priorities |
| packages/spec/src/api/index.ts | Export statements for new registry and documentation modules |
| examples/api-registry-example.ts | Complete usage example with 605 lines demonstrating REST, GraphQL, and Plugin API registration with Swagger UI configuration |
| packages/spec/json-schema/api/*.json | 24 generated JSON schema placeholder files for new types (populated by build script) |
| content/docs/references/api/meta.json | Documentation index updated with registry and documentation entries |
| content/docs/references/api/index.mdx | Documentation cards added for new API modules |
| IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md | Comprehensive implementation summary documenting problem statement, solution, and benefits |
| API_REGISTRY_ENHANCEMENTS.md | Detailed documentation of four key enhancements (RBAC, dynamic schemas, protocol extensibility, conflict detection) |
</details>

The file reference path in the JSDoc @see tag is incorrect. The path `file://../../permission/permission.zod.ts` uses a relative path that doesn't match the actual file structure. 

Since this file is at `packages/spec/src/api/registry.zod.ts` and the permission file is at `packages/spec/src/permission/permission.zod.ts`, the correct relative path should be `../permission/permission.zod.ts` (one level up, not two).
